sourceObject.name: Stubborn Resolve
sourceObject.description: Constitution 15+ supports the listed resistance to one death effect per day.
sourceObject.effect: Once per long rest, when you fail a saving throw against an effect that would kill you outright, reroll the save and use the new result.
sourceObject.legacyEffect: Can resist 1 death effect per day
sourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

currentPublic.operationalRules: Once per completed long rest, after you fail an actual saving throw whose currently applicable failure outcome directly makes you Dead, you may spend the feat's use to reroll under the shared replacement procedure before death commits. NEW eligible examples include an explicit save-or-die effect and a Wound save begun at three Wounds, where another failure is immediately fatal. An ordinary damage save does not qualify merely because the eventual damage could reduce HP to zero or meet Instant Death; that save's failure outcome is damage, not direct death. Ordinary death saving throws and their accumulated failure counters are a separate Core procedure and do not qualify here. No-save direct death, an already committed death, a maximum-HP clamp or a future delayed risk supplies no new save. Use the new result even if it still kills; there is no resurrection or automatic survival. Preserve legacy death-effect 'resistance' wording as inactive beside this explicit current reroll proposal. A separately eligible would-die replacement still keeps its own later legal window if the new result remains fatal.

currentPublic.name: Survivalist

sourceObject.name: Survivalist
sourceObject.description: You excel at surviving in harsh conditions.
sourceObject.effect: You can survive in any environment and can help others do the same. You need only half the normal amount of food and water.

currentPublic.operationalRules:
Consume half your actual normal food requirement and half your actual normal potable-water requirement under the governing body/environment schedule. Keep the two quantities separate and exact; purchase indivisible containers or portions as needed but retain unused contents rather than rounding each consumption upward. NEW: choose the strongest applicable fractional requirement reduction instead of multiplying overlapping reductions. This does not erase existing deprivation or replace required breathing, shelter, equipment or rest. To complete the source's broad survival/help clause, NEW proposal: you have advantage on actual Survival checks to adapt a camp, clothing, route or shelter to an ordinary nonmagical environment and on Constitution saves caused solely by ordinary heat/cold exposure. During one active hour preparing a camp or travel plan, you can designate up to PB actual companions participating in that preparation; while they follow the plan and keep its required gear, they share the heat/cold-save advantage for the next eight elapsed hours. This does not confer food/water reduction on them, make unsafe material edible, or permit survival in lava, vacuum, drowning, magical extremes or an environment with no physically possible protective method. Actual hazard frequency, severity, DC and finite protection still apply. These explicit environmental limits are proposed replacements for the source's undefined absolute phrase, not a claim that it already said them.
The canonical daily standard is2lb food and8pints water, so this feat requires1lb/4pints; a Large consumer requires2lb/8pints rather than its ordinary4lb/16pints. currentPublic.operationalRules: NEW feat-only geometry: you and one other willing allied, non-Incapacitated creature each threaten the same enemy with an actual legal melee attack, and the straight segment joining your occupied-space centers crosses the interior of that enemy's occupied footprint, placing you on opposite sides. Measure actual occupied bodies on the current map; a large creature needs opposite sides of its whole footprint, not merely two nearby squares. Both participants must perceive the target and be able to attack it; total cover or unusable reach prevents flanking. This geometry itself grants no universal advantage. Once per turn, when either participant hits that enemy with a melee attack, you may assign your feat allowance to add1d6 of one native damage type to that hit before damage is rolled. No Action/Reaction is required, but you must be conscious and able to coordinate. One successful attack may receive only one Tactical Flanker die across all owners; choose its funding owner before rolling. A critical doubles this attack rider die. Misses spend nothing; using your allowance on an ally prevents using it again on your own hit that actual turn. Perception/reach/geometry must hold at the hit.

sourceObject.name: Target Mark
sourceObject.description: Wisdom 14+ and Ranged support the listed mark that increases damage taken by the target.
sourceObject.effect: As a bonus action, mark a creature you can see within weapon range for 1 minute. The first attack by each ally against it gains +1 to hit. You may maintain only one mark and regain this use after a short rest.
sourceObject.legacyEffect: Mark target to take 10% more dmg
sourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

currentPublic.operationalRules:
Bonus Action, once per short rest: while holding an actual usable weapon, choose a creature you can see within its current melee reach or printed maximum ranged range, with line of effect. A thrown weapon uses its actual range; ordinary long-range disadvantages remain. Record the chosen weapon only to establish activation range; stowing it later does not end the mark. For1minute, the first attack against the marked creature by each creature currently allied to you, including yourself, gains+1 to hit. sourceObject.name: Telekinetic
sourceObject.description: You have learned to move things with your mind.
sourceObject.effect: You learn the mage hand cantrip and can cast it without verbal or somatic components. You can use it to shove creatures.

currentPublic.operationalRules:
Choose INT,WIS orCHA permanently for this feat. Learn the exact ordinary Mage Hand identity (`mage-hand`,Universal rank0), using a NEW feat route with that chosen casting ability. Waive only its V/Scomponents for casts through this feat; a genuinely added other requirement remains. It is a real cast with its actual Action,shared Refrain/strain and interruption eligibility; absence of V/Sdoes not itself grant invisibility or hide an observable manifestation. Keep the current LRXvisible hand,no creature/objectHP,concentration up to1minute,30-foot control range,10lb/1-foot-cube unattended-object capacity,10-foot movement per caster Action and cargo-release rules. It does not become the different Transmutation Magehand identity.

NEW explicit creature-shove exception: as the one manipulation of the creation Action or a later Action commanding this actual hand, you may move the hand up to its ordinary10feet along a visible unobstructed path and attempt to shove one visible Large-or-smaller creature within5feet of the hand and within30feet of you. The target makes STRsave against8+PB+your feat ability modifier. On failure choose before resolution to push it5feet directly away from you along a legal supported path, or knock itProne; on success neither. This replaces the ordinary physical opposed-Shove roll only for this feat; no body-size growth,damage,pull,grapple or extra attack. Actual forced-movement/Prone immunities and geometry apply. No free object manipulation accompanies the shove. Each attempt uses its own legal Action; extra Actions do not refresh other resources, and there is no Bonus Action or autonomous-hand turn. If range/path/concentration is lost, the hand cannot shove and its normal ending/release rules apply. It supplies no ordinary spell-component hand or attended-object theft.
workedCases: Creating the visible hand can include one legal shove attempt instead of lifting an object. The target passes itsSTRsave, so no movement orProne occurs; the casting Action and chronological strain record remain spent.

A later shove command is an Action using the existing hand, not another cast and not free telepathic manipulation. A creature beyond30feet cannot be shoved by claiming the hand has a separate unrestricted reach.

currentPublic.name: Telepathic

sourceObject.name: Telepathic
sourceObject.description: You can reach out to others with your mind.
sourceObject.effect: You can communicate telepathically with creatures and cast detect thoughts once per long rest.

currentPublic.operationalRules:
Choose INT,WIS orCHA permanently as this feat’s casting ability. NEW communication procedure: while conscious, you may direct one brief intentional message at a time to one perceived willing conscious creature within60feet and line of effect, with the same ordinary conversational timing as speech and no extra Action. A willing recipient may reply through that same temporary channel while eligibility continues. Shared language permits normal phrases; absent a shared language, only a simple voluntarily conveyed image,emotion or basic idea is received, not automatic precise translation. The recipient may refuse or end the exchange; silence supplies no diagnosis of presence,thought,consent or mind protection. This grants no reading,compulsion,command authority,remote tracking,hidden-creature search or ability to use telepathy as a spell’s Vcomponent. Loss of range,line or consciousness ends the channel. It supplies no simultaneous group channel or extra reaction-time instructions beyond actual turn rules.

The named Detect Thoughts has no exact entry in the848ordinary plus10supplemental ancestry source catalogs. NEW proposed feat-only spell payload, explicitly not an alias for Read Surface Thoughts: rank2Divination,Action,V/S/F,one perceived creature within30feet and line of effect,concentration up to1minute. The feat gives one cast per beneficial Long Rest through the common charge route. At initial resolution and on a later Action spent on this one same target while it remains in range/line, request one sample and make a fresh targetWISsave against the featDC. A failed save reveals one actual current conscious surface thought under the already reviewed Read Surface Thoughts information limits; success reveals none. The initial cast Action includes at most one sample. No new sample occurs without its real Action, and repeated sampling does not recast or replay Dissonance. NEW the target becomes aware of an attempted mental intrusion at the first sample, regardless of its save, without automatically identifying a hidden caster.

An absent conscious thought,protection or failed information access supplies no reason-diagnosis; ordinary dreams are not conscious thoughts without a specific exception. Preserve verbal thoughts’ actual language and nonverbal impressions without inventing meaning. There is no memory search,truth enforcement,forced subject,biography,creature-type cognition assumption or automatic translation. Specific information protections,including actual Divination/Scrying protection,apply. No target switch within the one cast; loss of its range/line prevents sampling while the original deadline continues, and ending concentration ends the attempt. The new supplemental profile must be accepted/replaced by GPT before any use; it does not add ordinary class access or silently claim a missing original definition was recovered.
workedCases: Two willing creatures sharing no language can exchange a simple image of an open door through the channel; this does not translate an unknown legal contract or read unspoken motives.

A legal Detect Thoughts cast is followed by two later sampling Actions. The target makes three distinct saves total; only actual failed samples expose the thought currently present then, and none compels it to think about the caster’s preferred question.

This never raises maximumHP, refreshes charges/service, repairs a missing body or turns an unsuccessful check into success. Neither the feat nor taking a rest creates a free generic repair attempt.

currentPublic.name: Tracker

sourceObject.name: Tracker
sourceObject.description: You can follow tracks across any terrain.
sourceObject.effect: You can track creatures across any surface, including water and air. You can determine the age, size, and condition of tracks.

currentPublic.operationalRules: The source expressly allows tracking over water and air. NEW proposed completion preserves a real exceptional benefit: from an actual known starting trail or witnessed passage, you can perceive faint physical-passage impressions of that same creature's continuous route within60feet of your position for up to24elapsed hours after passage, including its waterborne or airborne segments. This is a feat-local extraordinary trail sense, not free knowledge of every nearby creature. Spend one active minute examining a segment and make Wisdom (Survival) DC15, increased by5 when the trail is more than12hours old and by5 where multiple actual trails are heavily intermingled; an exact concealing source may expressly block or modify this sensing. On success follow the actual local direction and learn the passage's approximate age, creature size and evident physical condition such as limping or bleeding. No exact current HP, identity, destination, invisible present location, future path or unobserved intent is revealed. You still need a physically possible way to traverse the route, time at your legal tracking pace and a new real examination when a junction or lost segment creates uncertainty. Teleportation supplies no traversed intervening path; track ends at departure and resumes only after separately finding the arrival trail. No new plane/soul/cosmological mechanism is inferred. Failed unchanged examination cannot be rerolled without changed access, evidence or method. This exceptional-sense choice needs explicit GPT review against mundane tracking and divination.

currentPublic.name: Trap Sense

sourceObject.name: Trap Sense
sourceObject.description: Perception 4+ and Level 5 support the listed passive trap detection.
sourceObject.effect: You may notice traps with passive Perception even while moving at a normal pace, and gain +2 on saves against traps you can see.
sourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

currentPublic.operationalRules: At the adopted normal travel pace, you may use passive Perception to notice a trap's actually detectable clue. NEW: compare 10 plus the relevant Wisdom (Perception) modifier, with applicable PB once, to the trap's stated detection DC; meeting it notices the clue. There is no natural d20 or generic passive ±5 from advantage/disadvantage. A source explicitly requiring an active search or a different sense still controls; concealment, line, range and sensory access remain. Detecting a clue does not reveal every component or disarm the device. Add +2 to a saving throw against a trap you can actually see at the save event, including a visible operative component sufficient to recognize the incoming trap effect. A remembered location behind total visual obstruction is not sight. An ordinary creature attack or unrelated hazard is not a trap solely because it surprises you. If a source explicitly classifies a magical installation as a trap, retain that classification and its save rules.
workedCases: Passive 15 notices an accessible trap clue at DC 15 during normal-pace travel. A completely invisible clue with no applicable sense is not noticed by the arithmetic alone.

sourceObject.description: Wisdom 14+ supports the listed +2 to Intimidation resistance.

currentPublic.operationalRules: Add +2 when you make an actual saving throw or opposed check whose operative purpose is resisting intimidation, coercion or fear. Use the defending ability/skill actually assigned by the effect or declared contest: for example Wisdom (Insight) against a manipulative Deception attempt only when the declared stake is coercive influence, rather than general lie detection. NEW: ordinary social exchanges do not gain an invented saving throw solely because you own this feat. A fixed-DC task check is not a contested check and receives no bonus from this wording unless another exact source includes it. An actual saving throw to end Frightened can qualify; immunity, an effect without a save and an automatic condition expiration are not bonus-bearing rolls. Retain binary-save rules, contested ties and all non-roll prerequisites. This does not change a player character's beliefs or compel an NPC to obey a failed check.

sourceObject.name: Unstoppable Force
sourceObject.description: Strength 14+ and Level 8 support the listed +10% knockback chance.
sourceObject.effect: When you push or knock a creature, increase the distance by 5 feet. Once per turn, a creature that fails the save by 5 or more is also knocked prone.
sourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

currentPublic.operationalRules: Whenever your own direct legal effect pushes or knocks a creature a positive specified distance away from you or along its printed outward direction, increase that displacement by5ft. It can modify a weapon, ordinary maneuver, spell or class effect if you are the actual source; not a companion's own effect, pull, teleport, fall, current, carried movement or copy/transfer. Preserve its original size/eligibility/path. Add the5 once per displacement event; same-family copies do not add further5. The final movement still stops at walls, anchors and illegal positions. Once per turn, if that same displacement-producing effect has an actual STR/DEX/other save which the target fails by5 or more, also apply Prone independently of blocked displacement. No save is invented for an ordinary opposed Shove; its numerical contest difference is not a save failure margin. Automatic failure has no numerical margin unless its source explicitly says otherwise. If an original effect already applies Prone, do not duplicate it.

currentPublic.name: Void Touched

sourceObject.name: Void Touched
sourceObject.description: You have been exposed to the void between planes.
sourceObject.effect: You have resistance to necrotic damage and can see normally in magical darkness.

currentPublic.operationalRules: Gain resistance to necrotic damage. You can see normally through magical darkness with your current functioning visual sense. NEW precise scope: within the range at which that body's normal vision can resolve a subject under adequate light, treat magical darkness's obscuring effect as absent for your sight; where the magic itself creates a dark region, treat that region as normally lit for this personal perception. This emits no light and grants no benefit to allies. Independent ordinary darkness beyond that region, non-darkness fog/smoke, total cover, invisible creatures, lack of eyes, Blinded and an actual vision-range limit still apply. It neither creates a new visual sense in a sightless form nor extends a specified sense range. Existing necrotic resistance does not stack. The name/descriptive void connection grants no planar origin, alignment change, creature type or other cosmological assertion.
workedCases: A visible unobstructed target inside magical darkness can be seen by a holder with functioning ordinary sight. An invisible target remains invisible without another exact ability.
A wall still blocks sight and a sightless form gains no eyes from this feat; necrotic resistance remains its separate benefit where otherwise operative.

currentPublic.name: Volley

sourceObject.name: Volley
sourceObject.description: Level 8 supports the listed rain of arrows in a small area.
sourceObject.effect: Rain arrows in small area.
sourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

currentPublic.operationalRules: NEW full completion: Action, once per short rest, wield a loaded/properly supplied bow using arrows and choose a visible point within that bow's actual normal range and line of effect. Select up to PB distinct perceived creatures in a10ft-radius area around that point, each independently in normal range and with a legal shot. You may exclude allies; no hidden-target scan or compulsory friendly fire is added. Lock targets/order, spend the use and one actual arrow per selected target, then make one separate normal ranged weapon attack against each. Apply actual AC, cover, proficiency, crits and ordinary native bow damage to each; there is no area save/DC or shared damage roll. Extra Attack does not multiply this special Action. Each target at most once; newly entering creatures cannot replace lost targets. A target becoming illegal before its shot is skipped and its committed arrow remains spent. Interrupted remaining shots lose the use and committed ammunition. Loading/reload and all other item restrictions remain, so a weapon that cannot fire the necessary arrows cannot declare that many shots. It is a special Volley Action, not Attack Action for Double Tap or Eldritch Combat.
workedCases: PB3 with a bow selects three enemies and commits3arrows; roll three separate attacks and damage only actual hits.
A wall gives one target total cover before its shot. Skip it without a replacement target or arrow refund; the other legal shots remain.

currentPublic.name: War Caster

sourceObject.name: War Caster
sourceObject.description: You have practiced casting spells in the midst of combat.
sourceObject.prerequisite: Ability to cast at least one spell
sourceObject.effect: You have advantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain concentration on spells.

currentPublic.operationalRules: Require actual acquired spellcasting. You have advantage on CONsaving throws whose actual purpose is maintaining concentration on a spell you are sustaining. This includes a real damage-triggered concentration save or another explicit CONsave to retain that spell, and no other roll merely because losing it might later break concentration. Use the existing damage-event timing and one-save procedure; temporaryHP absorption and actual damage consequences retain their governing definitions. Ordinary nonproficient-armor disadvantage or another actual disadvantage cancels the advantage normally; neither produces additional dice. A source-specific flat concentration bonus such as the proposed Resilient Mind applies separately if genuinely eligible under its own rule. WoundCONsaves,death saves,ordinary Strain/Exhaustion saves and nonspell concentration checks do not qualify simply because this creature also casts spells. The sole printed effect grants no occupied-hand Spermission,Reaction spell,reaction attack,automatic success or second concentration slot.
workedCases: Damage causes one CONsave to maintain a real spell concentration. War Caster grants advantage, but nonproficient worn armor’s actual concentration disadvantage cancels it to one die.
The same damage event causes a WoundCONsave as well. That separate save gains no War Caster advantage, even if becoming incapacitated from its consequences would end concentration.

Damage still uses its original ability unless the weapon's actual Finesse property or another feature independently changes damage too. ChoosingDEX here does not grant the Finesse property, change weapon weight/hands/reach, make a Heavy weapon light, waive STR/size requirements, or qualify for a STR-attack-only Power Attack. Actual PB requires actual proficiency as before. Source attack-modifier-dependent save DCs, such as Disarming Blow, use the actual DEX attack modifier when this swap applied; STR-fixed feats retain STR.

currentCompleteContract.completeOperativeProcedure: NEW complete interpretation: surrounded means at least two different conscious hostile creatures within5ft of you, on opposite sides under Tactical Flanker's center-segment geometry, each currently able to attack you in melee. While that predicate holds, gain+1AC as an explicit conversion of the source's undefined+5% evasion; this is not literal5%damage reduction or a separate avoidance roll. Once on your own turn, after your melee weapon attack hits a creature while surrounded, you may deal a cleave packet to one different perceived hostile creature within the actual reach of that same weapon. Amount is floor10% of that hit's eligible native weapon damage before percentages/defenses; allocate native types as shared arithmetic. No second attack roll, no new critical and no on-hit riders/resources from this derived packet; ordinary recipient defenses apply. The primary attack can be fully mitigated and still supply its legal pre-defense native amount, but a missed attack cannot. Cleave needs real reach/line, deals0 if the rounded amount is0, and cannot itself cleave or trigger a drop-generated attack/heal. Losing surrounded geometry ends AC immediately.

currentPublic.name: Wilderness Chef

sourceObject.name: Wilderness Chef
sourceObject.description: Nature 4+ and Wisdom 13+ support the listed forage bonus effects.
sourceObject.effect: Forage creates +2 bonus effects.
sourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

currentPublic.operationalRules: The current source names two bonus effects without defining either. NEW complete proposal for discussion: once per completed long rest, after you personally finish a legal successful forage task yielding actual edible material, designate at most your current PB ordinary portions from that finite yield. Spend 30 active minutes with an actual cooking kit, safe heat and water if the food needs them to prepare those portions. No extra food, ingredients or Supply are created; record the original forage batch and its real quantities. Each designated portion has exactly two proposed riders: (1) Trail-ready preparation pauses its ordinary unprotected spoilage clock for the next six elapsed hours while kept clean in an appropriate container, after which its prior age resumes; breach or contamination ends this protection and other preservation does not add the intervals. (2) The eater may add +1 to one actual Constitution save against ordinary foodborne illness or food poisoning within one elapsed hour after fully consuming the portion, declaring before that roll. This does not work against magical poison, weapon poison, existing illness or non-food hazards. Record one recipient entitlement per completed long rest across all Wilderness Chefs; consuming another portion neither refreshes nor stacks it. Pay the cook's use at preparation start, even if interrupted. A poisoned or unsafe ingredient is not made edible; no other cooked recipe, Chef-serving or Feast effect is added to the same physical portion. These two riders are deliberately proposed new text, not recovered source or an interpretation of the legacy +10%.
workedCases: A PB 3 cook legally forages only two portions: the batch can prepare two, not three. It consumes real food and 30 minutes, and pauses each portion's prior spoilage age for at most six hours.

A recipient consumes two different cooks' portions before resting: there is one +1 entitlement, one fixed one-hour deadline from the first qualifying portion, and no +2 or timer refresh. A poisoned ingredient remains poisoned.

currentPublic.name: Wilderness Walker

sourceObject.name: Wilderness Walker
sourceObject.description: Survival 4+ supports the listed freedom from terrain movement penalties.
sourceObject.effect: No movement penalty in terrain.
sourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

currentPublic.operationalRules: Use the shared Skill-feat proposal's explicit acquisition bridge for Survival4+: actual Survival proficiency and permanent ordinary skill modifier at least+4, excluding temporary/situational bonuses. NEW broad completion of 'no movement penalty in terrain': when your own body moves through an actually traversable route, ignore extra movement-cost factors and Speed reductions whose sole stated cause is the terrain itself, including ordinary difficult/severe ground and magical terrain that only imposes those movement penalties. Crawling, squeezing, load, injury, creature conditions, lack of a movement mode, occupied-space restrictions, forced movement and an actual obstruction remain separate causes and still apply. A terrain hazard's attack, save, damage, falling risk or inflicted Grappled/Restrained condition is not itself waived; if its separate condition reduces Speed, that condition remains. In strategic travel remove only your own terrain-derived rate penalty, not every party member's; the group still uses its actual slowest participant. A mount, vehicle or carried companion does not inherit your feat. Mode switching retains spent movement costs and never refunds earlier expenditure. This deliberately proposes broad terrain-cost protection, including qualifying magical terrain, and needs exact spell/hazard comparisons rather than silently narrowing the source to woodland alone.
workedCases: Crawling and squeezing through difficult terrain normally costs4feet per foot under current Core. Removing the terrain surcharge leaves3feet per foot: base1, crawling1 and squeezing1.
A magical bog that only doubles terrain movement cost can be crossed at ordinary terrain cost. If its separate failed save inflicts Restrained, the resulting Speed0 remains until that condition ends.

currentPublic.name: Anatomy Lore

sourceObject.name: Anatomy Lore
sourceObject.description: You have studied the weak joints, organs, and pressure points of giants, ogres, and other colossal foes common to Aethel's wilds. Prestige lineage: Giant Killer. completed from the existing development record.)
sourceObject.prerequisite: Intelligence 13+, proficiency in Knowledge (Monstrous Humanoids) or Survival
sourceObject.effect: As a bonus action, you can identify one weak point on a Large or larger creature you can see. Your next attack against that creature deals +50% damage if it hits, or you gain advantage on the attack if the target is Huge or larger. Once per short rest, when you hit a colossal foe with this advantage, you may force it to succeed on a Strength save or have its speed halved until the end of your next turn.
sourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.
sourceObject.legacyEffect: As a bonus action, you can identify one weak point on a Large or larger creature you can see. Your next attack against that creature deals +50% damage if it hits, or you gain advantage on the attack if the target is Huge or larger. currentPublic.operationalRules: As a Bonus Action, mark one actually visible Large-or-larger creature with a perceivable physical weak point and legal line of effect. NEW: maximum range 60 feet; keep at most one such mark, replacing the old one without refund. At marking choose damage mode, or advantage mode if the target is Huge or larger. The mark lasts until the end of your next original regular turn, using the current virtual-marker rules if initiative changes. It is consumed by your next actual attack roll against that target, hit or miss; attacks against others neither consume it nor receive its benefit. Damage mode applies to the next actual personally owned attack, including a melee or ranged spell attack. It adds floor(50% of that attack's nonnegative native damage after its actual critical-dice adjustment), once before saves/defenses. Include only the native attack's dice and ordinary native ability modifier. Exclude separate riders, Smite/sneak dice, copied/reflected damage and other percentage enhancements from the base. A spell with no attack roll cannot consume or benefit from the mark. Add this extra amount as the attack's native damage type before target defenses, once. Advantage mode gives advantage to that next attack; ordinary cancellation still applies. Once per completed short rest, after an actual hit from advantage mode against a Huge-or-larger marked target, you may spend the use to force a Strength save against DC 8 + PB + INT modifier. On failure halve that target's current applicable movement Speeds until the end of your next original regular turn; do not stack same-family halves. NEW: the rider can qualify when the feat's advantage was canceled, because the selected paid mode still applied. The creature must possess relevant anatomy; no taxonomy or immunity is rewritten. NEW distinct percentage feats each calculate their own eligible native base and add their separately floored amounts without compounding, under FS-04. Hostile movement reductions use the existing strongest-slow arbitration, not this additive damage rule.
workedCases: A marked native attack, including an eligible spell attack, totals10 after its native critical adjustment. Anatomy Lore adds5 before defenses; an independent eligible50% feat adds its own5, not50% of15. A separate1d6 rider is outside both native bases.

A Huge target is marked in advantage mode; disadvantage cancels advantage and the attack still hits. The short-rest slow use may be spent; its STR success prevents the slow. Its failed save halves Speed30 to15; an existing-10 hostile slow does not make that10.

currentPublic.operationalRules: Gain advantage on actual Animal Handling and Survival checks involving beasts; this alone gives no new permitted check or beast language. NEW combat-read procedure: spend an Action observing one visible actual beast within 60 feet with legal line of effect; make Wisdom (Survival) against DC 10 + its recorded CR, rounding the final DC upward. Do not infer a missing CR. On success learn its actual diet, temperament and observed combat habits to the extent those are knowable from the evidence. Choose participating allies within 30 feet who can perceive and understand your briefing; those allies gain +2 to attack rolls against that one creature for one elapsed minute. You may be included as an ally. Keep at most one active briefing per feat owner; a new successful briefing replaces the old. Same-feat briefings on the same attacker/target do not stack. The separate beast call takes one Action and spends the short-rest use at the attempt: call an actually present nonhostile beast within 300 feet, CR 1 or lower, through a signal it can perceive, and make Wisdom (Survival) DC 15. On success it approaches by its actual movement and a possible route, then attempts one physically safe simple task you describe: tracking, carrying within capacity, or a non-damaging distraction. NEW: its task lasts at most one minute from arrival, with an overall ten-minute deadline from the call; interruption, incapacity or an impossible route can prevent completion. The Director retains its actual agency and behavior; it does not obey suicidal orders or become permanently friendly. No eligible beast means no created beast, no roll and no spent use. unchangedReviewedRecord.operationalRules:
## Blood Ritual — Magic; Constitution13+ and character level4+

Perform a ten-minute ritual once per completed long rest. Commit the use at ritual start. Snapshot your character level, PB and selected targets then: yourself plus up to PB **other** willing allies. Each ally must remain within10ft throughout, witness the ritual and voluntarily contribute a drop of blood. There is no normal-HP payment. No substitutions are allowed after starting.

At completion, offer yourself `2 × snapshotted character level` temporary HP with default lifetime. Each continuously eligible selected ally receives `snapshotted character level` temporary HP for one elapsed hour. A departed/ineligible ally loses only its own benefit. Your interruption fails the whole unfinished ritual and the use remains spent until a real rest resets it.

You also gain advantage on your next actual saving throw against an effect explicitly classified as a curse or disease. This rider is independent of the shield: rejection, replacement or depletion of temporary HP does not remove it. It ends when you roll that qualifying save or complete your next long rest, whichever is first. Consume it on the roll even if advantage cancels disadvantage or the save fails. It neither cures nor waives Oracle's intrinsic Curse and grants no oath or transformation.

If completion is strictly before a long-rest endpoint, the self shield/rider expire at that rest normally. At an exact tied completion, resolve old rest expirations, advance the epoch/reset resources, finalize Chef if applicable, then complete the tied ritual; its new shield/rider belong to the new epoch. Its already-committed start use is never retroactively refunded.

**NEW:** PB ally cap, presence/willingness details, use timing and independent save-rider deadline. Self/ally amounts and the ally's hour follow the reconciled source.

currentPublic.name: Companion Training

sourceObject.name: Companion Training
sourceObject.description: Your beasts do not merely follow—they fight as extensions of your will across Aethel's wild tiers, answering whistle and gesture like soldiers who never learned fear. Prestige lineage: Beastmaster. completed from the existing development record.)
sourceObject.prerequisite: Animal Companion feat or proficiency in Animal Handling
sourceObject.effect: Beast companions you command gain +2 to attack and damage rolls and inherit your Survival proficiency for tracking. As a bonus action, command one companion to attack, dash, disengage, or help; at level 10+, you may issue the same command to two companions that can hear you. When a companion reduces a foe to 0 HP, you gain advantage on your next attack against a creature within 30 feet before the end of your next turn.

currentPublic.operationalRules:
Require the exact Animal Companion feat OR actual Animal Handling proficiency. Your genuinely bound/tamed Beast companions under your lawful current command gain+2 to their attack rolls and+2flat once per native attack damage roll, not per die/type or critical doubling. NEW no benefit to an ordinary allied Beast, non-Beast construct/undead/familiar, or a body you have no actual companion/control relation with. Original source-owner stats remain; add this feat layer once across overlapping trainers. For real tracking checks, if you are proficient in Survival, the companion uses its ownWIS plus your currentPB as the inherited proficiency contribution; expertise is not inherited, and a better real own contribution can replace it, not add twice. If you lack Survival proficiency, nothing is inherited. During your regular turn spend the sharedBAcommand within60ft to one companion that can hear you, selecting attack, Dash, Disengage or Help. At total level10+, the same command can name two audible owned companions taking that same action in their attached phases. This changes command recipient count only: one shared offensive companion action per owner numbered round remains. For attack, designate at most one to spend that offense; the other may move defensively and Dodge, not bank an attack. Two pure support actions can both resolve if legal. Command fails without refund if eligibility is lost; no extra independent turns/Reactions. When one of your actually commanded Beast companions reduces a meaningful hostile from positiveHP to0, you gain one advantage entitlement for your next attack against a creature within30ft of you before your next future regular end. NEW only an attack meeting30ft consumes it; a farther attack does not. Same-family reapplication refreshes one entitlement/deadline, never queues multiple. Death is not required, source floors/copy/no-reward restrictions apply.
NEW explicit EX58 interface: retain one real creature identity and one current control/phase record. Riding, bonding or transferring custody does not clone a turn, movement budget, Reaction, attack allowance, body or resource pool. An attached companion acts in its source-defined phase after the owner’s regular turn; a controlled mount uses EX58’s actual mounted-phase procedure. A body fitting both roles elects one compatible route before that round’s work, preserves all already-spent allowances and cannot switch routes to gain a second phase. Its actual load, tack, rider geometry, mounting/dismounting cost and ordinary independent temperament remain. One shared Bonus Action command and one offensive companion action per owner per numbered round apply where those source engines impose them. This feat supplies no blanket override of a specific engine’s attack or no-resource restrictions.
workedCases: At level10, two companions can each perform a legal Help from the one shared command; an Attack command still permits only one shared offensive action.
A commanded Beast downs a hostile: the owner's next attack within30ft gains advantage before the deadline; no extra attack is granted.

sourceObject.description: Seeds answer your call, rooting as guardians, lashing as spears, blooming as verdict. Prestige lineage: Verdant Animist. completed from the existing development record.)
sourceObject.effect: Once per short rest, you conjure one immobile plant spirit (seedling) within 30 feet for 1 minute. It can lash for thorn damage, release spores, or entangle a 10-foot square. You may maintain one additional seedling at level 10+. As a bonus action, you may command all active seedlings to lash one creature within 10 feet of any seedling for 1d6 piercing damage (save for half).

currentPublic.operationalRules:

NEW to make the second-capacity clause usable, at level 10 this same committed use permits one additional Action before the first plant expires to create one second plant; no second rest use, no later replacement of that spent creation. This is an explicit proposed addition to the printed one-seedling creation, not a recovered rule. Each plant gets its own minute. Choose its mode/burst type at creation. One BA may command all active plants within 60 ft able to perceive you, but produces only ONE selected mode outcome per round under the shared offensive-companion allowance. Lash chooses one creature within 10 ft of any participating plant for 1d6 piercing, DEX save half. Spore and entangle use their full profiles. No autonomous turn, opportunity attacks, harvest, loot, Supply, corpse or resource-generating death. Destruction/expiry permanently consumes the body.
NEW ordinary command scheduling: each plant has one attached phase immediately after its owner’s regular turn, not an independent initiative turn. Its ordinary commanded action requires the owner’s shared Bonus Action within60ft through the specified perceivable command channel and spends the one offensive companion allowance per owner per numbered round if offensive. With no legal command it has no autonomous attack. Trapcasting’s explicitly adopted entry-trigger or burst is a separate narrow exception spending that same shared offensive allowance, never another free attack.

This source choice is separate from the later seedling mode/burst-type choice. Ownership initializes only the finite creation allowance and body capacity, with no plant, pending additional creation, command or active effect. All printed acquisition predicates and the actual earned feat opportunity remain required.

currentPublic.operationalRules:
Require actual Smith’s-tools/Blacksmithing proficiency and either actual spellcasting ability or actual Engineering proficiency. At completion of your beneficial Long Rest, you may touch one functional weapon or armor suit for which you have a genuine personal lead-crafter receipt and place one infusion on it for24elapsed hours. NEW: your own qualifying transformative manufacture counts, but buying, repairing or merely assisting does not. One active infusion per owner; replacing it ends the old one. One infusion slot per body across all owners; a new consensual infusion replaces the existing one rather than adding. The creature holding/wearing it must actually allow the accessible operation; no remote overwrite.

Choose one NEW closed minor property: a weapon adds+1fire to each actual hit made with it; an armor suit gains+1AC in equipment.defense-enhancement; or either body grants resistance to one chosen acid,cold,fire,lightning or thunder damage type while actually properly worn as armor or wielded as a functional weapon. The+1fire is a flat component of the same hit, not critical-doubled or an independent proc; it does not enhance spells merely cast while holding the weapon. Resistances do not double with same-type resistance. The magical infusion suspends while Broken, suppressed, melded or otherwise unusable, with its original clock running; repair/unsuppression can resume the remaining time but cannot refresh it. It is magical item functionality, not a spell, concentration or Counterspell target. The feat grants no Relic item or additional Relic property: any actual Relic work still requires its specifically authorized design, rare materials, forge and access, beyond this closed menu.

While you actually wear/wield your own currently active, usable infused item, gain+2 to actual Blacksmithing repair checks on that same item. Once per Short Rest you may reroll one failed actual Craft check on that same item under the shared reroll timing while this wear/wield eligibility holds. NEW: Craft here includes otherwise authorized Blacksmithing creation/alteration/repair checks actually acting on that item, not unrelated Engineering or research. Physical work still needs the source’s real tools/position and safe access; wearing a suit during a repair is not automatically feasible. A Broken item supplies neither bonus nor reroll because it cannot be functionally worn/wielded for the infusion. The reroll expends only this allowance, pays no duplicate batch cost, and never resurrects an ineligible work order.
workedCases: A personally made functional armor suit with an existing equipment.defense-enhancement+2gains no additionalAC from choosing this infusion’s+1. Choosing a real different resistance instead can supply that separate property.

An infused weapon breaks six hours into its24-hour duration. Its fire property and repair-check feat benefit suspend. Lawful repair four hours later can restore the remaining fourteen hours, not a new full day or free reroll while Broken.

currentPublic.operationalRules: Require Constitution 13 and total character level 6 at acquisition. For the two damage defenses, the holder must currently have an actual operative transformation or an explicitly recorded lycanthropic curse. A cosmetic disguise, feat name or inferred origin is insufficient. Gain resistance to nonmagical slashing damage and halve an actual silver weapon's own damage components, including any intrinsic item-profile components. Separate poison doses, class/feat riders and spell damage are not silver-weapon damage merely because the weapon hit delivered their trigger, unless an exact source says they are part of that weapon's own damage. NEW: the two passive halves supplied by this same feat form one defensive family; a nonmagical silver slashing hit is halved once by this family, not automatically quartered. Resolve separate actually applicable defenses by the governing damage pipeline. Gain advantage on actual saves to resist an involuntary transformation, without creating a save for a no-save change. Once per completed long rest, when a real positive-to-zero HP transition would occur while actually transformed, you may spend the use to remain at 1 HP instead. NEW: this is a true drop-prevention floor after Instant Death checking and before later Wound consequences; it does not override Instant Death, fatal Wounds, an already-zero state, actual death or a mandatory unpreventable cost. Extend only the current transformation's ordinary time endpoint, if needed, to at least the end of your next original regular turn. It does not shorten a longer duration, create another form, waive upkeep, prevent voluntary ending or preserve a form through independently failed concentration, invalid anatomy, suppression or another mandatory source ending. Keep the source's origin/curse language as a literal eligibility receipt without inventing a curse.
workedCases: An eligible nonmagical silver slashing packet of 11 is halved once by this feat's own passive family, yielding 5 before any other distinct legally ordered stage, not 2 from counting both clauses twice.
A transformed positive-HP holder can spend the floor use on an eligible drop, but a subsequent failed Wound save begun at three Wounds can still kill under Core. The feat is not resurrection.

While your occupied space is actually dim/dark, gainStealthadvantage subject to ordinary hiding/perception; NEW whole footprint must qualify. Once SR/LR use BA from such a space to teleport up to 15 ft into an unoccupied fitting space you can see that is also dim/dark. No traversed path, but NEW line of effect to destination required; obey actual teleport/consent/restraint restrictions. Costs/use commit normally; no invisibility, freeHide, ancestry conversion or soul/origin claim.
NEW exact darkvision branch, replacing any dynamic fallback reading: snapshot whether an independent darkvision source exists at acquisition. No source then gives a60ft base; an existing source then gives a+30ft extension to the current strongest independent operative range. Losing/suppressing every underlying source makes that extension inoperative, not a new60ft base. Record the branch permanently; unrelated future base ranges use normal strongest-base arbitration.

currentPublic.operationalRules: Require Curse Channeling OR character 8. Spend one uninterrupted hour in contact with one actual owned/willingly entrusted weapon carrying an established curse record; no feat-created curse, weapon or hidden curse diagnosis. NEW ritual needs your voluntary symbolic drop of blood but no numeric HP/material charge, and is unrelated to Blood Ritual. Completion replaces your old binding; interrupted work creates none and leaves the old. While personally wielding the bound original weapon, you cannot be involuntarily disarmed by an actual disarm effect; mandatory dropping from Unconscious/incapacity, loss of body/hand, voluntary release and physical destruction still apply. currentPublic.name: Favored Enemy (Dragon)

sourceObject.name: Favored Enemy (Dragon)
sourceObject.description: You have studied scaled tyrants—their breath, their pride, the tell before the roar. Prestige lineage: Wyrmslayer. completed from the existing development record.)
sourceObject.effect: You deal +2 damage to dragons and dragonkin. You have advantage on Survival and Lore checks to identify dragon ancestry, breath type, and lair habits. When you succeed on such a check against a dragon you can see, you and allies within 30 feet gain +1 to saving throws against that dragon's breath weapon until the end of the encounter. You cannot be frightened by a dragon's presence for more than 1 round, and once per short rest you may ignore difficult terrain caused by a dragon's lair hazards (molten glass, acidic pools, or shattered stone) while pursuing that wyrm.

currentPublic.operationalRules: Use actual supplied creature-type/tag facts: Dragon and expressly recorded dragonkin qualify for the+2damage and knowledge clauses; do not infer these tags from a humanoid ancestry name or settle origins. Add+2flat once per own direct damage event against a qualifying creature, of one native type, before defenses; no copied, periodic, reflected or controller-owned companion event. Advantage applies to genuine Survival tracking/ecology checks and NEW INT Nature checks representing the source's undefined Lore for physical draconic ancestry traits, breath type and lair habits; Arcana/History can use their actual separate task if relevant but receive no automatic substitute proficiency. NEW in initiative spend Action to observe a visible dragon within60ft, outside initiative1minute; DC=10+ceil(actualCR), or15 when noCR exists, adjusted only for explicitly established concealment of facts. Success gives one useful actually available requested fact, not sealed origins. On such success against a visible actual Dragon, brief other willing allies within30ft who can perceive/understand you; you and those fixed recipients gain+1 to saves against that individual dragon's breath through encounter end. Same feat family does not stack and later entrants require a new successful actual read/brief. Fear caused specifically by a dragon's presence lasts at most through your next future original regular start, then that source record ends; other fear remains. Once per SR, no Action during your movement while actually pursuing that dragon, ignore difficult-terrain movement surcharge caused by its real lair hazards through the current turn's end (outside initiative6seconds). Hazard damage/saves and impassability remain. No real bestiary record is retyped by this proposal.

It then has disadvantage on its next attack against you before its next future regular end, consumed hit or miss. currentPublic.operationalRules:
While conscious and actually holding a weapon in a legal grip, you cannot be involuntarily disarmed of that weapon. NEW: resolve an otherwise valid disarm attempt normally to determine whether it would succeed, then keep the weapon and deal1d4bludgeoning directly to that initiating attacker instead, subject to its ordinary defenses. This is the source’s special retaliation even for a legal ranged disarm; it is not an attack, critical hit, spell, weapon-damage proc or reflected copy, and cannot recursively trigger itself. A failed attempt deals nothing. It does not prevent voluntary release, destruction/Broken state, severed anatomy, a legal whole-body movement or losing consciousness, and does not protect unrelated held objects merely because they are called important. Add+2 to actual Craft(Blacksmith)/Smith’s-tools checks within the real tool scope. You may wield an actually profiled weapon one size category larger without the penalty imposed solely by that size mismatch; no extra size/damage/reach/hands/proficiency is created. This and Giant Strength confer the same one-category permission, not two categories.

Once per Short Rest, use a Bonus Action while conscious/capable and legally gripping a weapon to lock your grip. Until your next original regular-turn start, opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage. Separately, the next legal melee hit you make during that duration gains+1d6of its ordinary melee damage type only if your cumulative actual displacement since locking is at most5feet. NEW: count voluntary/forced movement, carried movement and actual teleport displacement; in-place rotation is0. Once displacement exceeds5feet, the damage opportunity is lost for this activation even if you return; the opportunity-attack disadvantage persists for its original duration. On the first qualifying hit commit the rider once, with its attack dice doubled on a critical, in the same event. No further rider, free attack or extra Reaction follows. Losing consciousness ends this activation; ending initiative preserves its next regular-start deadline through the existing six-second outside timing, without refresh. Extra turns do not advance the original regular-start expiry.

unchangedReviewedRecord.operationalRules:
## Lifeleech — Magic; actual spellcasting ability

Before your spell's damage resolves, designate one eligible hostile target for that spell root and canonical round/window. Your first positive actual necrotic damage to that target in the window commits the entitlement, even if the eventual healing is0, prohibited, capped or unfunded. No retargeting after observing results; area spells do not harvest a separate heal from every target. The same continuing spell can qualify again in a later real round/window.

Raw self-healing is `floor(actual necrotic damage dealt /2)`. Use only the actual necrotic component, including actual temporary-HP absorption and normal HP lost under the existing actual-damage interface; no overkill. Targets must be genuine hostile opposition, not friendly/staged/trivial sacrifices or owner/ally-generated farming bodies. Natural attacks, Agony Lance and the Necrotic Affinity die alone are not spells. The feat removes no Wounds and cannot resurrect its dead owner.

**NEW finite resource — Lifeleech Recovery Reserve:** newly acquiring the feat starts at0. At each actual completed long rest set its capacity and remaining points to `2 × current character level`, snapshotted then. Level/PB changes between rests do not refill/recompute it. This reserve is neither RP nor Mutation Recovery Reserve. Persistent save imports must preserve validated spent state.

Run the ordinary two-pass healing modifiers/reductions/prohibitions. Preview uses available reserve to determine whether conditional bonuses requiring positive actual HP restoration qualify. Apply reductions before funding. Cap final legal healing potential by remaining reserve; spend that **entire funded amount** on commitment, including funded excess. All lawful healing bonuses consume this same reserve. Then restore HP subject to ordinary maximum HP and Critical ceiling, and calculate `genuine excess = max(0, funded amount − ordinary missing HP)`.

A broad HP-gain prohibition produces0 legal amount, spends0 reserve and creates0 excess. At reserve0 the round/root trigger still commits, but it produces neither restoration nor excess. Full HP can produce funded excess, but does not enable conditional bonuses requiring actual HP restoration. Critical's ceiling does not itself turn all unrestored points into excess.

Lifeleech provides no intrinsic excess converter. A separately authorized converter must have its own eligibility/cost/cadence/cap and consume each funded excess point once. An explicitly legal resource-output converter remains possible; incidental heal-triggered resource production is blocked. The child heal carries `noLifeleechRetrigger`, `blockHealCopyTriggers` and `blockResourceTriggers`; propagate these to downstream callers. The resource flag blocks incidental triggers, not an exact, separately paid excess-conversion transaction. No new resource converter is granted here.

Lifeleech also automatically collects one Soul Charge at an eligible hostile soul-bearing creature's actual death within30ft, perceived with legal line of effect. No crystal is required for Lifeleech's own collection. Use the shared resource/death rules below. Lifeleech alone cannot spend charges through abilities from the unowned Soul Cage feat.

## Lifeleech — Magic; actual spellcasting ability

Before your spell's damage resolves, designate one eligible hostile target for that spell root and canonical round/window. Your first positive actual necrotic damage to that target in the window commits the entitlement, even if the eventual healing is0, prohibited, capped or unfunded. No retargeting after observing results; area spells do not harvest a separate heal from every target. The same continuing spell can qualify again in a later real round/window.

Raw self-healing is `floor(actual necrotic damage dealt /2)`. Use only the actual necrotic component, including actual temporary-HP absorption and normal HP lost under the existing actual-damage interface; no overkill. Targets must be genuine hostile opposition, not friendly/staged/trivial sacrifices or owner/ally-generated farming bodies. Natural attacks, Agony Lance and the Necrotic Affinity die alone are not spells. The feat removes no Wounds and cannot resurrect its dead owner.

**NEW finite resource — Lifeleech Recovery Reserve:** newly acquiring the feat starts at0. At each actual completed long rest set its capacity and remaining points to `2 × current character level`, snapshotted then. Level/PB changes between rests do not refill/recompute it. This reserve is neither RP nor Mutation Recovery Reserve. Persistent save imports must preserve validated spent state.

Run the ordinary two-pass healing modifiers/reductions/prohibitions. Preview uses available reserve to determine whether conditional bonuses requiring positive actual HP restoration qualify. Apply reductions before funding. Cap final legal healing potential by remaining reserve; spend that **entire funded amount** on commitment, including funded excess. All lawful healing bonuses consume this same reserve. Then restore HP subject to ordinary maximum HP and Critical ceiling, and calculate `genuine excess = max(0, funded amount − ordinary missing HP)`.

A broad HP-gain prohibition produces0 legal amount, spends0 reserve and creates0 excess. At reserve0 the round/root trigger still commits, but it produces neither restoration nor excess. Full HP can produce funded excess, but does not enable conditional bonuses requiring actual HP restoration. Critical's ceiling does not itself turn all unrestored points into excess.

Lifeleech provides no intrinsic excess converter. A separately authorized converter must have its own eligibility/cost/cadence/cap and consume each funded excess point once. An explicitly legal resource-output converter remains possible; incidental heal-triggered resource production is blocked. The child heal carries `noLifeleechRetrigger`, `blockHealCopyTriggers` and `blockResourceTriggers`; propagate these to downstream callers. The resource flag blocks incidental triggers, not an exact, separately paid excess-conversion transaction. No new resource converter is granted here.

Lifeleech also automatically collects one Soul Charge at an eligible hostile soul-bearing creature's actual death within30ft, perceived with legal line of effect. No crystal is required for Lifeleech's own collection. Use the shared resource/death rules below. Lifeleech alone cannot spend charges through abilities from the unowned Soul Cage feat.

currentPublic.name: Lightning Affinity

sourceObject.name: Lightning Affinity
sourceObject.description: Storm-blood runs quiet in you until the sky asks it to speak. Prestige lineage: Storm Lord. completed from the existing development record.)
sourceObject.prerequisite: Spellcasting ability or proficiency in Nature
sourceObject.effect: You have resistance to lightning damage. Your lightning spells deal +1 damage per die and ignore half cover when the target is outdoors or under open sky. You have advantage on saving throws against electrical and paralyzing effects. When you take lightning damage, you can use your reaction to store the excess (after resistance) as Storm Charge (max 2); spend 1 charge to add 1d6 lightning to your next spell or weapon attack before the end of your next turn.

currentPublic.operationalRules:
Gain lightning resistance and+1 damage per actual native lightning die in your personally cast spells, including native critical dice, as a flat adjustment before save/defense; no bonus per flatpoint, added nonlightning die or copied packet. Against a target actually outdoors/open-sky, your lightning spell attack/save geometry ignores halfcover only; threequarters/total cover remain. Gainadvantage on actual saves against a lightning/electrical payload or a component imposingParalyzed, not everyCONsave. After a hostile meaningful lightning packet deals positive actual numeric damage to you, spendReaction to gain oneStormCharge, max 2. NEW no charge per damagepoint; genuine tempHPabsorption qualifies, fully prevented/floor-only numeric 0 doesnot. Each charge lasts one minute from gain; no maximum cap refresh from a rejected gain. On your own turn, spend one charge withoutAction to prime your next personal weapon attack or immediate damaging spell before next regular end: add 1d6 lightning to one selected hit/packet/shared area roll under added-die rules. Attackmiss consumes the primed rider; no stacking multiplecharges on oneactivation. No charge from self/cooperative/copy/retaliationdamage.
Preserve per-charge origin and expiry: receiving a further charge at capacity does not refresh an older charge. FS-07 respects each underlying spell’s no-resource/trigger flags. The native lightning-die+1 excludes external riders and secondary/copy results; it can add to an independently eligible Evocation Focus bonus on an actually rolled kept die, not on a fictitious maximized face.
workedCases: A native 3d6 lightningspell adds 3 before saves; a reaction to 8 actual lightningdamage gains 1 charge, not 8.
A miss wastes the primed die; a later attack cannot recover that spent charge.

currentPublic.name: Master Smithing

sourceObject.name: Master Smithing
sourceObject.description: Kings queue for your steel. You measure temper, fold, and spell-work in the same breath. Prestige lineage: Forge Master. completed from the existing development record.)
sourceObject.effect: You can craft masterwork weapons and armor and work toward relic-tier items with appropriate materials and a forge access. Armor you craft reduces armor check penalty by 1 and may include one minor property (e.g., fire resistance 5, silent movement, or +1 to a saving throw) chosen at completion. Weapons you craft gain +1 to damage rolls; once per week you may temper one weapon you personally forged, granting it a named masterwork trait (flaming edge, returning throw, or spell-holding groove) that lasts until the weapon is broken or reforged.

currentPublic.operationalRules:
Require actual Smith’s-tools/Blacksmithing proficiency and INT13. You may use the shared bounded mundane-creation bridge for its legal metal weapon/armor models, or an independently accessible reviewed recipe with all its original gates. “Masterwork” remains an earned quality result, not automatic equipment grade. Relic-tier work still needs an actual authorized design, rare materials, forge and access; this feat does not create a new relic catalog or bypass protected content.

NEW on genuine personal lead completion: an armor suit you craft reduces by1 an actual numeric armor-check penalty imposed by that suit, minimum0penalty; it creates no such penalty where none exists and does not remove Stealth disadvantage or a STR/Load/nonproficiency consequence. At completion choose at most one permanent minor armor property: flat fire reduction5after normal fire resistance/vulnerability but before Forge’s percentage layer; silent movement removing only that suit’s own armor-Stealth disadvantage; or+1to one chosen ability’s saving throws in the existing equipment.jewel-save-enhancement family. The fire/silence/save property is magical, suspends while the suit is Broken, suppressed, melded or improperly worn, and resumes only if the actual suit is lawfully restored. The numeric armor-check workmanship is physical. These properties do not themselves confer a generic new equipment grade, formula, enchantment slot or immunity. Your genuinely crafted weapon gains a permanent physical+1to its ordinary weapon-damage component on a legal hit, usable by its actual wielder; no automatic magical damage eligibility or critical doubling of the flat bonus. One same-feat workmanship identity per physical output, not another+1on each later alteration.

NEW weekly temper: no earlier than168elapsed hours after your previous successful temper completion, spend8active hours at an actual forge with Smith’s tools,25gp-reference/1lb of actual suitable tempering metal,resin and ink stock and one functional weapon you personally forged. This fixed alteration is not creation-time-discounted; no extra quality roll, output or XP. Commit supplies at start and finish only after all work; interrupted phases follow the craft framework. Record completion and select one named trait below. One trait slot per body; replacing a trait requires another lawful temper and ends the old one. Its magical trait lasts until the weapon becomes Broken or is actually reforged; breaking ends it permanently, ordinary repair does not restore it. Suppression merely pauses usable benefits while the body survives.

Flaming edge: on one actual legal weapon hit per actual turn, you may add1d4fire as part of that same event, doubled on an attack critical. NEW: it shares the weapon’s one printed-elemental-rider expenditure family with any actual Blacksmithing elemental rider; choose one qualifying rider, do not spend the same item/turn for both. Use the reviewed Blacksmithing outside-window, host-turn and transition-guard procedure in full, including persistent physical identity and no refund after mitigation.

Returning throw: after a legal thrown attack with this actual weapon resolves, it may immediately return along a clear unobstructed route of at most60feet to its thrower. An actual compatible free hand catches it; otherwise it lands at the thrower’s feet. It cannot return while Broken, caught/held by another creature, pinned, or across an impassable obstruction; no teleport, automatic escape from custody, extra attack or altered weapon range. An ammunition weapon itself being improvised-thrown uses its actual legal attack, but fired arrows are different bodies and do not inherit this trait.

Spell-holding groove: NEW one-use inscription capacity, not a stored paid cast. An eligible caster spends10active minutes with writing implements and5gp of actual suitable ink to encode one exact independently reviewed ordinary rank1spell the caster genuinely knows through a current casting source. Keep its source identity and complete restrictions; encoding spends noRP and grants no class/list/rank access. One eligible reader may later use that one payload under the reviewed Scribing temporary-repertoire casting rule: actual class/list placement, level/rank, ordinary RP,components,casting time,concentration and cadence all apply; commit and erase the inscription when the cast commits, even if countered. Actual accessible readable groove, functional weapon and source-legal free hands are required; wielding this weapon is not automatically a focus. It gives no extra Action, attack-triggered free spell, automatic hit or spell damage added to a weapon attack. One groove/one payload; a new encoding replaces an unspent one with new work/ink. Ending/breaking/reforging the trait destroys its inscription without a refund.
workedCases: You craft an ordinary suit with no numeric armor-check penalty and choose silent movement. There is no invented-1check bonus; only the suit’s own Stealth disadvantage is removed while that magical property functions, leaving Burden or other Stealth disadvantages intact.

A tempered flaming weapon becomes Broken after its rider was spent. Repair restores its legal body and permanent physical craft workmanship, but not the ended temper trait or a fresh rider budget. A later lawful temper needs the168-hour cadence,8hours and real stock again.

unchangedReviewedRecord.operationalRules:
## Necrotic Affinity — Magic; Religion proficiency **or** character level8+

You have resistance to necrotic damage. Once per actual turn, when you hit with a melee attack, you may add1d6 necrotic damage. Natural/form melee attacks and off-turn Reaction attacks can qualify. A critical hit doubles this die to2d6; extra Actions in the same turn do not refresh it, while a genuinely different extra turn has its own entitlement. The die is feat damage, not spell damage.

Preserve the previously reviewed absorption procedure: when a legal necrotic spell/supernatural packet reaches the post-passive-defense stage, you may pay your Reaction to prevent `floor(post-defense necrotic damage /2)` before the old temporary-HP buffer. Resolve the remaining canonical damage once. Afterwards, if the holder remains living, offer temporary HP equal to the prevented amount until the end of the holder's next original regular turn, using its real endpoint marker. A1-point packet spends the Reaction but prevents/grants0. New temporary HP cannot absorb that same packet. Use `BufferLedger.necrotic_affinity` and `finish_necrotic_affinity`; do not apply resistance or damage twice.

When a creature actually dies from a canonical fatal damage/death root containing positive qualifying necrotic harm **owned by you**, attach a Necrotic Affinity seal to that death instance for24 elapsed hours. This includes your spells, the feat die, Agony Lance or another genuinely personal necrotic source. It is not limited to the feat's1d6. Supplying a summoned/transformed creature's statistics does not make its damage yours.

A mixed-type fatal root qualifies if your positive resolved necrotic component belongs to that root and the root actually causes death; no counterfactual subtraction test. Direct Instant Death, fatal death failures at0HP, or a later consequence expressly preserving that necrotic causal root can qualify. Temporary-HP-only absorption with no harmful consequence does not establish a seal.

The seal blocks applicable resurrection with an **actual spellRank/effectiveRank0..5**. Never invent a rank for unranked class features. Reviewed Paladin Grace Reversal is rank5 and is blocked; ordinary Resurrection7 and True Resurrection9 are above this restriction. Other resurrection requirements and Soul Bind still apply independently.

Same owner/death instance does not duplicate; different owners can have separate endpoints, but boolean blocking does not compound. currentPublic.name: Siege Savant

sourceObject.name: Siege Savant
sourceObject.description: You read walls like books—knowing which stone sighs before it falls. Prestige lineage: Sapper. completed from the existing development record.)
sourceObject.effect: You deal +20% damage to constructs, fortifications, and siege engines. Explosives you deploy have +5 feet radius and ignore half cover on the detonation save. You can identify structural weak points with a successful Engineering check, granting allies advantage on the next attack against that structure or construct. Once per short rest, you may collapse a 5-foot section of mundane wall or barricade you have studied for 1 round, creating difficult terrain and granting allies half cover behind the rubble until cleared.
sourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.
sourceObject.legacyEffect: You deal +20% damage to constructs, fortifications, and siege engines. Explosives you deploy have +5 feet radius and ignore half cover on the detonation save. You can identify structural weak points with a successful Engineering check, granting allies advantage on the next attack against that structure or construct. currentPublic.operationalRules:
Require actual Engineering proficiency. You deal+20%damage with an actual personally caused eligible damage event against a creature actually typed Construct, an independently profiled fortification component or a siege-engine body. NEW: this includes legal direct weapon/spell damage and a genuinely attributable deployed explosive/trap, but grants no object targeting to creature-only effects and excludes copied/reflected damage, another operator’s event, HP-cost payments and a rider already counted through the same event. Determine eligible ordinary damage components including their normal dice and flat bonuses before target defenses; compute one bonus floor(0.20×their nonnegative total). Allocate that integer bonus proportionally among their actual damage types by largest remainder, with ties in the event’s recorded component order; this preserves types and avoids rounding every small component up. Do not recursively increase other percentage bonuses or the generated bonus. Apply actual defenses after the increase; this feature alone does not make damage magical.

An actual explosive you personally deploy gains+5feet to its explicitly circular/spherical blast radius, and targets do not receive half-cover bonuses on that explosion’s actual detonation save. NEW: do not invent a save or radius for a single-target/nonradial effect; three-quarters and total cover remain, and targeting/origin/line rules still apply. Allies are not exempt from the enlarged area. A source expressly prohibiting modification keeps that prohibition. Nonexplosive spells do not become explosives by description.

NEW weak-point study: spend an Action observing a visible structure/component or Construct within60feet and make INT/Engineering againstDC15for ordinary visible engineering orDC20for a genuinely unusual but diagnostically exposed design. An unsupported/fully hidden weakness cannot be invented. On Success/Critical Success, identify one actual weak point to allies who can perceive your explanation within30feet; the next legal attack by one such informed ally against that exact target within1minute has advantage, consumed when declared even if advantage cancels. The marker does not stack and expires if the structure meaningfully changes. Failure allows a retry only after genuinely changed evidence/method, not another free look each round.

Once per Short Rest, after studying one actual mundane wall/barricade section within30feet continuously from your regular-turn start through the start of your next regular turn (six elapsed seconds outside initiative), spend an Action adjacent to it with actual suitable demolition tools to collapse one exposed section at most5feet wide,5feet high and1foot thick. NEW size bounds complete “5-foot section”; thicker bodies lose only that genuine separable section, not an invented tunnel through the remaining wall. A wholly magical barrier is ineligible; a unique mundane wall is not immune merely by its name. The section must be physically reachable and its collapse possible from the actual exposed construction; no automatic reach through other walls. Record real structural/load consequences before use; this does not automatically collapse an entire building. The selected section becomes actual rubble in its original footprint, ordinary difficult terrain and half cover for creatures genuinely positioned behind it, including enemies where the same physical cover applies. It remains until real work clears it. NEW generic clearing is10active minutes per collapsed section with suitable tools/storage for displaced rubble; missing destination or tools prevents clearance. No automatic crushing damage or ejection into occupied space is created; use an independently supported hazard if actual bystanders/loads require one.
workedCases: An eligible event has3piercing and3fire before defenses. Its6total adds1bonus; equal remainders give that1to the first recorded component, producing4piercing/3fire before separate defenses, not an untyped bonus.

A10-foot-radius explosive becomes15feet and ignores half-cover save bonuses, affecting actual allies too. Total cover can still exclude a target; this feature never changes an ordinary single-target Fire Bolt into a blast.
